annotations.title: Survey control monuments, NS BC NL (paid)

description: PAID, per call: look up survey control monuments in Nova Scotia (NS), British Columbia (BC) and Newfoundland and Labrador (NL), by monument id, by a bounding box, or the nearest monuments to a latitude and longitude (up to 25, nearest first, with the distance). Every monument carries its 10 figure military grid reference (MGRS, 1 m precision). Returns id, coordinates, type, condition and assessment date where the province publishes them, with the province's licence and attribution line on every answer. No images are returned. You are not charged when nothing matches.

bbox.description: Bounding box in decimal degrees, at most 2 degrees on a side. Give this or monument_id, not both.

lat.description: Nearest search: latitude in decimal degrees. Give lat and lon together, instead of monument_id or bbox.

limit.description: Nearest search only: how many monuments, nearest first. Default 10, at most 25.

lon.description: Nearest search: longitude in decimal degrees.

monument_id.description: The station or monument id, as the province publishes it. Give this or bbox, not both.

radius_km.description: Nearest search only: search radius in km. Default and maximum 50.

name: lookup_survey_monuments
